name: Thalassodromeus
isnote: Thalassodromids are treated as a subfamily of Tapejaridae by some authors and as close to azhdarchids by others.
sum: ‘Sea runner’: the largest thalassodromid, with a huge bony head crest, from the Romualdo Formation of Brazil.
holotype: DGM 1476-R — Romualdo Formation, Santana do Cariri, Ceará (found 1983).
biology: Originally thought to skim the water like a skimmer bird; experiments rejected this. Its strong jaws suggest it may have killed fairly large prey on the ground.
author: Kellner and Campos 2002
